question.text: PMs offering services to Accredited Investors can have:

answer.text: Lower minimum ticket sizes / customised strategies

explanation.text: The Logic: Accredited Investor regime enables customisation and lower thresholds (even < Rs. 50 lakh in some cases) — recognising investor sophistication. The Trap: AI regime relaxes, not tightens. Cross-Exam Context: New in 2022; XXI-B expects knowledge. Manager's Pro-Tip: Verify AI status via SEBI's accreditation agency — don't skip the paperwork.
